blocks.text: Perfect portion. Striking a simply chic pose, the Caitbrook dining set is styled with fascinating flair. Subtle gray wash finish gives the clean-lined design a casually cool sensibility, while the chair’s plushly cushioned seat in a soft, neutral upholstery adds to the allure.

items.label: SEVEN-PIECE DINING SET
items.value: Striking a simply chic pose, this dining set is styled with fascinating flair

items.label: WELL CRAFTED
items.value: Constructed with acacia veneer and wood solids. A subtle gray wash finish gives the clean-lined design a casually cool sensibility

items.label: SIX CHAIRS
items.value: X-back chairs feature solid wood frames and cushioned covered seats with a gray textured polyester fabric and nailhead trim

items.label: PERFECTLY SIZED
items.value: The dining table measures 36" W x 60" D x 29.75" H. Each chair measures 19" W x 22.5" D x 38.13" H with a 19.75" seat height

items.label: ASSEMBLY REQUIRED
items.value: Easy-to-follow instructions and hardware included. Two people recommended. Screwdriver (not included) is required for assembly
